core_struggle: Is stressed about work and feels uneasy, with four hours of daily phone time.
mirror: Four hours on the phone, and the work stress still sitting with you when you finally put it down.

queries.hook: The weight of work that does not sit right, a mind that will not settle, and the phone still in hand when the day is over.
queries.diagnose: When the mind is not given one quiet minute, it runs after results it cannot hold; stress grows from a mind that has never been allowed to rest.
queries.steady: Praise and blame, success and failure, come and go; what is yours is the effort, and that is enough to stand on.
queries.act: Let the phone rest for one hour, and give the mind one quiet minute before sleep.
queries.story: A warrior who stood before battle and found the stillness to act, though the world around him was loud.

bridge: What you are living with is what the texts call a mind that won't settle, and that is where this week begins.
week_thesis: Seven days from a mind that will not settle to one quiet minute that holds the stress differently.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the unease and the phone in your hand, named without blame.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that the stress is a mind that has not been given one quiet minute to settle.
week_beats.steady: You hold that praise and blame come and go, and your effort is what is yours.
week_beats.act: You try giving the phone one hour of rest and the mind one quiet minute before sleep.
week_beats.story: A warrior who stood before battle and found the stillness to act shows you what one quiet minute can hold.

insight: You are stressed about work, and the phone is still in your hand when the day is over. The mind has never been given one quiet minute to settle.
seat: a working professional under thirty-five who is stressed about work
life_context: A working professional in their late twenties or early thirties; their day includes four hours on the phone and a mind that does not settle, because work stress has taken up residence.
details: daily phone time is four hours
